playbook: Same recipe as the site's tours (scripts/tours/narr_sdedov_v2.py, docs/receipts/RECEIPT-TOURS-V5-2026-08-21.md, voice-rig/pron-matrix.py): numbers spoken as gender-correct words, niqqud only on risk words (ריינבו, בוטיק, נדל״ן), commas and periods for pacing, no SSML, edge-tts he-IL-AvriNeural at -8%. Whisper A/B on 28.9.2026 (20 variants): 'שדה דוב' with the mater vav came through clearer than 'שְׂדֵה דּוֹב'; a comma after 'שדווח' made both 'שדווח' and 'אלפיים עשרים ושש' come through; 'שקלים למטר' is clearer than 'שקל למטר'; digits and words give the same speech for 81,800, so words stay. 'וואטסאפ' and 'לובי' are loanwords whisper-small never spells right in any variant.
note: Every line comes from data/rainbow-tel-aviv.json (the same page and file sources). 'text' is the line as written, 'spoken' is the exact TTS input. 'at' is seconds after the scene (or view) starts. narrate.py writes 'file', 'secs' and the scene timings.
